observations.behavior: Adds a BadRequest exception handler for the specific message 'Invalid resource name' in the temp-table cleanup routine, distinguishing it from other BadRequest errors.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the BigQuery warehouse connector from repeatedly capturing and alerting on a deterministic misconfiguration error (malformed project/dataset ID) during the best-effort cleanup of temporary destination tables, while still allowing other unexpected errors to be captured. This could reduce alert fatigue and unnecessary support tickets for a known configuration issue.

observations.behavior: Adds the string 'Invalid resource name' to the credential validation error check, treating it as an invalid identifier error.
observations.posthog_connection: This extends the credential validation failure classification to recognize the same malformed ID error, ensuring the connector does not proceed with invalid credentials. This could prevent failed warehouse connections and reduce downstream failures.

observations.behavior: Adds the string 'Invalid resource name' to the dictionary of non-retryable errors, mapping it to BIGQUERY_INVALID_IDENTIFIER_ERROR.
observations.posthog_connection: This classifies the error as non-retryable, meaning the warehouse connector will stop attempting the connection rather than retrying indefinitely. This could prevent resource exhaustion and allow users to address the configuration issue sooner.
